summary: Assertio Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive merger agreement with Zydus Worldwide DMCC (Parent) and Zara Merger Sub Inc. (Purchaser). Purchaser will commence a cash tender offer for all outstanding common shares at $23.50/share, implying a premium not explicitly stated. The board recommends the transaction, though no advisor named. Following the offer, Purchaser will merge into Assertio, leaving it as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Parent waived the requirement for a concurrent note offer. Convertible note holders have rights to require repurchase or convert at an increased rate upon a Fundamental Change. Watch for tender conditions and regulatory clearances.
